preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 200000.
The number of edges m must be at least n - 1 and at most 200000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v and 1 <= w <= 10**9 for u, v, w in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n and have a weight between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of operations required to make the MST unique without changing its cost.
